_comment: Verified company/legal facts for Oaks Solutions Pvt Ltd, used by app.reports.bid_generator to draft the covering letter and declarations of a generated bid pack. Every field here is transcribed from an actual issued certificate (see the company documents library for the source PDFs/scans) - nothing here is estimated or invented. Fields the source documents don't establish (turnover figures, bank details, current employee count) are deliberately left out or flagged 'to_be_verified' rather than guessed; app.reports.bid_generator must never fill those from anywhere but an uploaded company document.
pan_derivation_note: Characters 3-12 of the GSTIN above - verify against the actual PAN card in the company documents library before relying on this for a submission.

_letterhead_comment: Full-page A4 letterhead image (relative to config/) drawn behind every page of a bid pack that goes to the tendering authority. The content area is inset to clear its header logo/address and footer contact strip - see app.reports.bid_generator.LETTERHEAD_MARGINS.
_reference_documents_comment: Documents-library entries (by display name) that are background reading for drafting only - their text is fed to the AI drafter as company context, but they are never merged into or listed as enclosures of a bid pack. Any document whose name contains 'brochure' is treated this way too.
_standard_enclosures_comment: Documents-library entries (by display name) merged into every bid pack. Any other library document is enclosed only when it matches the tender's own requirements (see app.reports.bid_generator.select_enclosures).
